conventions.convention: Kronecker coefficients are multiplicities in the diagonal tensor product of complex Specht modules for the same S_n, with n ≥ 0 and S_0 trivial.

The tabloid Hermitian form is conjugate-linear in its first slot; the self-duality map instead uses the symmetric complex-bilinear form b(x,y) = Σ_T x_T y_T. The class-function inner product is linear in its first slot.

The internal product is transported integrally through Frobenius characteristic, is zero between distinct homogeneous degrees, and has unit h_n in degree n. The direct sum has no global internal-product unit.
First-row padding α[n] = (n − |α|, α_1, α_2, …) is defined exactly for n ≥ |α| + α_1. The empty partition has first part zero, and ∅[0] = ∅.
The padded coefficient sequence starts at the maximum of the three padding thresholds; below that common domain it is undefined, rather than zero. This definition asserts no stability.

Bounded reduction uses the corrected shear δ_i = max(0, ρ_i − ω_{i+1} − 2s), D_j = Σ_{i=j}^ℓ δ_i, and φ(θ)_j = θ_j − D_j. Missing parts are zero, and output zero parts are deleted. This is expressly different from the published block map.

Row-gap stability shifts the first k rows of λ and μ by t and only the first row of ν by tk. The parameter s = n − ν_1 stays fixed. The proof establishes the identity without first-part ordering; neither monotonicity nor immediate constancy for arbitrary triples is asserted.

The absence of a general positive combinatorial rule is recorded as a literature-status claim, not a nonexistence theorem. Its cited [Panova paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2502.20253v2), Abstract and Introduction, was opened and supports that qualification.

load_bearing.statement: For λ, μ, ν ⊢ n, n ≥ 0, over C, g(λ,μ,ν) is the multiplicity of S^ν in S^λ ⊗_C S^μ, defined as the dimension of its S^ν-isotypic component divided by dim_C S^ν.
For all partitions λ, μ, ν ⊢ n, g(λ,μ,ν) = ⟨χ^λχ^μ,χ^ν⟩ = (1/n!) Σ_{σ∈S_n} χ^λ(σ)χ^μ(σ)χ^ν(σ), using real-valuedness to remove conjugation on the third factor.
For homogeneous f ∈ Λ^m and g ∈ Λ^n, define f*g = ch(ch⁻¹(f)·ch⁻¹(g)) when m=n and zero when m≠n, then extend bilinearly. For λ, μ ⊢ n, s_λ*s_μ = Σ_{ν⊢n} g(λ,μ,ν)s_ν.
Let λ ⊢ n, τ ⊢ r and θ ⊢ n−r. Then s_λ*(s_τ s_θ) = Σ_{α⊢r, β⊢n−r} c^λ_{αβ}(s_α*s_τ)(s_β*s_θ) in Λ^n.

For λ, μ, ν ⊢ n of lengths at most ℓ, put s=n−ν_1, reading missing parts as zero. If |λ_i−μ_i|>s for some i≤ℓ, then g(λ,μ,ν)=0. Otherwise, with ρ=λ∩μ, ω=λ∪μ, ω_{ℓ+1}=0, δ_i=max(0,ρ_i−ω_{i+1}−2s), D_j=Σ_{i=j}^ℓδ_i and φ(θ)_j=θ_j−D_j, the map sends partitions satisfying ρ_j−s≤θ_j≤ω_j to partitions after deleting zero parts. The images φ(λ), φ(μ) have common size r; φ(ν)=(r−s,ν_2,ν_3,…) is a partition after deleting zero parts, with φ(ν)=∅ when r=s=0. Then g(λ,μ,ν)=g(φ(λ),φ(μ),φ(ν)) and r≤2sℓ².

Fix λ, μ, ν ⊢ n, k≥1 and s=n−ν_1, with missing parts zero and ν_1=0 when n=0. If λ_1≤μ_1≤ν_1 and min(λ_k,μ_k)≥max(λ_{k+1},μ_{k+1})+s, then g(λ+(t^k),μ+(t^k),ν+(tk))=g(λ,μ,ν) for every integer t≥0. For an arbitrary triple, this shifted sequence is constant for every integer t≥t_0, where t_0=max(0,s+max(λ_{k+1},μ_{k+1})−min(λ_k,μ_k)). The proof does not require first-part ordering. No monotonicity is asserted.
For a partition α and integer n≥0, α[n]=(n−|α|,α_1,α_2,…) is defined exactly when n≥|α|+α_1, with |∅|=∅_1=0 and ∅[0]=∅. Below the threshold it is undefined.

For every n≥0 and λ⊢n, coefficientwise multiplication in the tabloid basis gives a nondegenerate symmetric S_n-invariant complex-bilinear form on S^λ. The map v↦b(v,−) identifies S^λ with its dual; consequently χ^λ(g⁻¹)=χ^λ(g), and every irreducible character of S_n is real-valued.

For ρ, σ ⊢ n, p_ρ*p_σ = δ_{ρ,σ}z_ρp_ρ, where z_ρ=∏_i i^{m_i(ρ)}m_i(ρ)!. The internal product is diagonal in the rational power-sum basis and has integer Kronecker structure constants in the Schur basis.

concerns.concern: Proof 1.1 says ⟨Res χ^λ,φ_{αβ}⟩_H equals ⟨Ind φ_{αβ},χ^λ⟩_{S_n} by F3. F3 supplies the H-inner product with the slots reversed. The displayed equality needs Hermitian symmetry and the reality of character inner products, which follows from the cited multiplicity interpretation F5. This is an immediately closable justification omission; the resulting restriction expansion is sound.

The Statement calls (tk) 'the one-part partition of size tk' while quantifying over t≥0. At t=0 this is (0), which is not a partition under the published positive-part convention. Interpret this notation explicitly as a row-increment vector, or specify the empty partition at zero. The identity and proof remain valid at t=0.

seams_checked.note: Checked the page and its supplier-facing clauses in weight, free-module bounds, coinvariant detection, constituent bounds, uniform stability, padded character polynomials, eventual character polynomials, and the padded-family realization. They retain α[n]=(n−|α|,α_1,…), the exact admissibility threshold, and deletion of the first row as the inverse label construction. They do not attribute FI-module structure or stability to the neutral padding definition. The supplier page likewise leaves FI-module structure to these consumers.

Checked the page and its padding, internal-product, power-sum and multiplicity citations through the completion, compatibility, Murnaghan, reduced-coefficient, Brion, BOR-expansion and threshold items. The Murnaghan theorem explicitly introduces its own zero extension below the common padding domain; the reduced-coefficient definition expressly distinguishes that extension from the supplier's undefined sequence. Jacobi–Trudi completion below admissibility is also introduced locally. Equal-degree products, degreewise units and rational power-sum diagonalization agree with the suppliers; no consumer imports immediate constancy from the row-gap theorem.
